Theme

Latin word

cūrō

cūrō, cūrāre, cūrāvī, cūrātum

verb, first conjugation

care about; look after, take care of

In this lexicon

  • care

    the recommended word · classical · Plaut. Most. 627: nōn ego istuc cūrō quī sit quid sit unde sit; Cic. N. D. 2.167: magna dī cūrant, parva neglegunt; Traupman 94: Ista nōn cūrō.

  • care

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Att. 2.2.1: cūrā, amābō tē, Cicerōnem nostrum; Cato, Agr. 54: bovēs bene cūrāre

Examples

  • Nōn ego istuc cūrō quī sit quid sit unde sit

    I don’t care who he is, what he is or where he comes from.Plaut. Most. 627

    In the entry for care

  • nūllā in rē jam tē festīnāre volō; nihil labōrō, nisi ut salvus sīs

    I don’t want you to hurry over anything now; all I care about is that you get well.Cic. Fam. 16.4.3

    In the entry for care

  • magna dī cūrant, parva neglegunt
